description: This source file defines a test class for Orleans durable grain testing, specifically testing the DurableValue behavior within Orleans journaling tests.

classes.name: DurableValueTestGrain
classes.description: A test implementation of a durable grain that manages a string name and an integer counter, with methods for setting and retrieving values, along with accessing its activation ID.

methods.name: SetValues
methods.description: Sets the 'name' and 'counter' durable values and writes the state asynchronously.

methods.name: GetActivationId
methods.description: Returns the unique activation ID of this grain instance.
